verdict.rationale: Reverse ETL is a fair axis for a data movement platform, but the evidence only documents syncing from sources into a warehouse or data lake, plus in-destination transformations. Nothing shows activating modeled warehouse data back into CRM, ads, or support tools. A community comment even contrasts Fivetran (APIs into databases) with Census (databases out to APIs), and the generic 'power operations' marketing line does not establish the capability.
